killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole hides a collapsed legal document with display, not with a class that does nothing
why: The modifier reduced to a class that styles nothing -- the same shape as `app-ground-hidden-modifier-does-nothing` and `.hud-splash--hidden`, one pane further in. EVERY OTHER ASSERTION ABOUT A COLLAPSED DOCUMENT READS THE CLASS, not the resolved display: legal.test.ts checks `classList.contains`, hud.surfaces.test.ts filters on the same class, and hud.css.test.ts's presence sweep uses `toContain('.hud-legal-body--hidden')`, which an empty rule satisfies. So without this entry's case the About pane would open with all five documents expanded -- roughly 25 KB of licence text between the intro prose and the Back button -- and nothing in the suite would be red. Killed only by the case that measures the SAME element with the modifier removed as its own control, so a stylesheet that hid documents unconditionally fails there too.
